QF.id: VB Fund Distribution and Channel Management_28

question.text: An exception to the no-commission rule on distributor change applies when the change is due to the old distributor's voluntary cessation of business. In this case, __________.

answer.text: The new distributor gets trail commission
The old distributor's nominee receives the trail commission
The AMC decides who receives the commission on a case-by-case basis

explanation.text: The Logic: Per the workbook, if the investor's distributor change is necessitated by the old distributor's voluntary cessation of business, the new distributor is entitled to receive trail commission. This is the stated exception to the general no-commission-on-change rule. The Trap: The nominee/legal-heir route applies to the separate scenario of a deceased distributor, not to voluntary cessation. The AMC-discretion option is incorrect because the rule is set by regulation rather than left to the AMC. Note: The voluntary-cessation exception and the deceased-distributor rule are two distinct workbook scenarios and should not be conflated.
